title: SII Vol. 18 No. 1 — Devageri
date_text: It seems to register a certain gift made at the request of Kali-Sinda
summary: Stone on the tank brand near the temple of Yellamma

title: SII Vol. 18 No. 2 — Ganajur
date_text: This record is engraved in characters of about the 8th century A.D. and it seems to refer itself to the reign of Vijaya[ditya]
summary: Being fragmentary and mutilated, its purport cannot be made out

title: SII Vol. 18 No. 3 — Bannikop
summary: Slab lying in front of the temple of Bhima

title: SII Vol. 18 No. 4
date_text: The characters of the record are of the 8th century A.D
summary: This inscription refers itself to the reign of Vijayaditya Satyasraya and records the death of a hero (name lost)

title: SII Vol. 18 No. 5 — Ganajur
summary: This fragmentary record engraved in characters of about the 7-8th century A.D. refers itself to the reign of [Vi]kramaditya, apparently one of the Chalukya rulers of that name, and a certain Revanna

title: SII Vol. 18 No. 6 — Devageri
date_text: This inscription, engraved in characters of about the 7-8th century A.D., records the death of a hero in a fight at Chendur
summary: Broken stone lying by the tank of Mallikarjuna

title: SII Vol. 18 No. 7 — Siruguppi
summary: Stone lying near the temple of Hundeda Hanuman
